description: One issue code from the latest finished site audit: title, how to fix it, severity and the affected pages ordered by impressions of the last 28 days (url, HTTP status, depth, in sitemap, clicks, impressions). Codes come from get_site_audit (for example title_missing, broken_internal_link, noindex_with_clicks). Site-wide codes (robots_missing, sitemap_missing, llms_txt_missing, ai_bots_blocked, robots_blocks_audit) have no page list. Use it after get_site_audit to see which pages to fix for one issue. / Um problema da auditoria: título, correção e páginas afetadas por impressões.

language.description: Language of issue titles and fixes (default en).

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. The value "demo" selects a demonstration site with fictional data: it works without signing in and is read-only. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id; "demo" é um site de demonstração com dados fictícios, sem login e só leitura.

name: get_audit_issue
title: Pages affected by an audit issue
